nodes.name: ReadLandlordNotices

nodes.name: ExtractRentChange
nodes.role: find the new rent amount and its effective date that the notices state

nodes.name: ValidateRentChange
nodes.role: check that the extracted rent change is a genuine rent-change notice and that its amount is plausible against the current rent

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: ask the user to approve the adjusted rent amount and effective date

nodes.name: AdjustRentPayment
nodes.role: set the rent payment to the approved amount from the approved effective date
